note: Majority: Law No. 32/2016 of 28/08/2016 governing persons and family (Official Gazette of 12/09/2016), article 113: majority at eighteen unless a law provides otherwise; emancipation (articles 114 to 116) isn't held. Work: Law No. 66/2018 of 30/08/2018 regulating labour in Rwanda (Official Gazette Special of 06/09/2018), article 5: the minimum age for admission to employment is sixteen; a child of 13 to 15 may do only light work in apprenticeship, on a list the Minister of labour sets. The law makes no exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below sixteen (my reading). Later amendments to Law 66/2018 weren't checked. Service: no conscription law was found and no Rwanda Defence Force page was read; service is left null. Texts read from RwandaLII's copies of the Official Gazette on 2026-10-31. Until 2026-11-03 RwandaLII's copies were cited as primary; they are a legal information institute's copy of the law, so secondary since the ruling of 2026-11-03, so they were relabelled, and both laws were read that day in the English column of the gazettes' own pages (Laws.Africa's publication scans): art. 113 and art. 5 say what was quoted, so nothing changed.
